Wenzhou Longchang Chemical Co., Ltd. is a professional chemical manufacturer and distributor based in the Lantian Industrial Zone, Yongzhong Town, Longwan District, China—one of Wenzhou’s most dynamic hubs for advanced manufacturing and logistics. Positioned near major transportation links, the company leverages its strategic location to provide reliable, timely supply to customers across China and international markets.

Longchang Chemical focuses on the development, production, and trade of a range of industrial and specialty chemical products tailored for applications in coatings, plastics, textiles, leather, adhesives, and related sectors. Guided by a customer-first philosophy, the company emphasizes stable quality, consistent specifications, and responsive technical support. Its operations prioritize process safety and environmental responsibility, with continuous improvements in raw material selection, waste reduction, and energy efficiency to support more sustainable supply chains.

Backed by an experienced team, Longchang Chemical offers flexible services that include custom formulation, contract manufacturing, and private-label packaging. The company maintains rigorous quality control from raw material intake through finished-goods delivery, supported by well-documented procedures and testing protocols. Through collaborative R&D and close communication, Longchang works to align product performance with customer process needs, aiming to lower total cost-in-use and enhance production efficiency.

With a pragmatic approach to market development, the company builds long-term partnerships with distributors, brand owners, and end users, offering tailored logistics solutions and steady supply planning. Whether supporting established product lines or developing bespoke solutions, Wenzhou Longchang Chemical Co., Ltd. is committed to dependable quality, professional service, and continuous improvement—delivering practical chemical solutions from its base in the Lantian Industrial Zone to customers at home and abroad.
